zh: 这个项目最近进度很慢，因为有两个同事请假了。
old_en: The project progress has been slow because two colleagues are on leave.
new_en: The project is moving slowly lately because two colleagues are on leave.

zh: 今天开会我迟到了，因为路上堵车。
old_en: I was late for the meeting because of the traffic jam.
new_en: I was late for the meeting today because of the traffic.

zh: 开会迟到了十分钟，因为路上特别堵。
old_en: I was ten minutes late for the meeting because the traffic was so bad.
new_en: I was ten minutes late for the meeting because the traffic was really bad.

zh: 我的方案被否了，因为预算太高。
old_en: My proposal was rejected because the budget was too high.
new_en: My proposal was turned down because the budget was too high.

zh: 方案没通过，因为老板觉得预算太高。
old_en: The proposal didn't pass because the boss thought the budget was too high.
new_en: The proposal didn't pass because the boss thought the budget was too high.

zh: 最近我总加班，因为部门人手不够。
old_en: I've been working overtime recently because there aren't enough people in the department.
new_en: I've been working overtime recently because the department is short-staffed.

zh: 最近天天加班，因为有两个同事离职了。
old_en: I've been working overtime every day recently because two colleagues quit.
new_en: I've been working overtime every day lately because two colleagues left.

zh: 我的论文要延期，因为数据出了问题。
old_en: My thesis was delayed because there were issues with the data.
new_en: My thesis needs to be delayed because there's a problem with the data.

zh: 论文延期了，因为有一部分数据不对。
old_en: The thesis was delayed because part of the data was incorrect.
new_en: The thesis was delayed because some of the data was wrong.

zh: 客户投诉了，因为送货太慢。
old_en: The customer complained because the delivery was too slow.
new_en: A customer complained because the delivery was too slow.

zh: 有客户投诉，因为快递比约定晚了两天。
old_en: There were customer complaints because the delivery was two days late.
new_en: There was a customer complaint because the delivery was two days late.

zh: 我最近学习效率很低，因为总被打断。
old_en: I've been studying inefficiently recently because I keep getting interrupted.
new_en: I've been studying inefficiently lately because I keep getting interrupted.

zh: 在家学习效率低，因为总有人来找我。
old_en: My study efficiency at home is low because people keep coming to find me.
new_en: I can't focus on studying at home because people keep coming over.

zh: 这次面试失败了，因为我太紧张。
old_en: I failed the interview because I was too nervous.
new_en: I failed the interview because I was too nervous.

zh: 项目进度慢，因为负责的同事这周请假。
old_en: The project is behind schedule because the responsible colleague is on leave this week.
new_en: The project is delayed because my colleague is on leave this week.

zh: 报告没写完，因为我的电脑坏了。
old_en: Because my computer broke, the report wasn't finished.
new_en: I couldn't finish the report because my computer broke.

zh: 我今天没交报告，因为电脑突然坏了。
old_en: I didn't submit the report today because my computer broke down.
new_en: I didn't submit the report today because my computer broke.

zh: 这次考试我没考好，因为复习时间不够。
old_en: I didn't do well in the test because I didn't have enough time to revise.
new_en: I didn't do well on the test because I didn't have enough time to study.

zh: 考试没考好，因为最近工作太忙，没时间复习。
old_en: I didn't do well in the exam because I've been too busy with work recently.
new_en: I didn't do well on the exam because I've been too busy with work lately and didn't have time to study.

zh: 面试没通过，因为当时太紧张，话都说不清。
old_en: Because I was too nervous, I couldn't even speak clearly.
new_en: I didn't pass the interview because I was too nervous and couldn't speak clearly.
